string.name: usb_err_no_iface
string.value: The USB device has no usable interface

string.name: usb_err_no_right
string.value: USB access was not granted; allow it in the system prompt and try again

string.name: usb_err_open
string.value: Failed to open the USB device: %s

string.name: usb_err_open_service
string.value: Failed to open the USB device

string.name: usb_err_webcam_mode
string.value: The console is in webcam mode: set SFT to USB - PC viewer and restart the console

string.name: usb_hint_no_device
string.value: No console found. Check that the console is in handheld mode, SFT is set to USB - PC viewer and was restarted, and the cable carries data. With a C-to-C cable a phone or tablet may end up as the USB device; replug a few times, or use an OTG adapter (C male to A female) with an A-to-C cable.

string.name: usb_hint_no_device_pc
string.value: No console found. Check that the console is in handheld mode and SFT is set to USB - PC viewer (restart after changing), then connect it to a USB port with a data cable.

string.name: usb_hint_unsupported
string.value: This device cannot act as a USB host; use the network instead.

string.name: usb_hint_wrong_mode
string.value: A USB device is connected, but not in SFT receiver mode: set Connection to USB - PC viewer in SFT (webcam mode is not supported) and restart the console.
